title: You Can't Always Tell
mainIdea: Things that seem like bad luck can sometimes lead to good outcomes.

pages.text: A father and son lost their home and belongings in a flood. They needed to find a safe place to stay.

question.text: Who are the main characters in the story?

pages.text: The son felt upset and believed they were very unlucky. The father reminded him, "You can't always tell."

question.text: What did the father and son want?
options: To find safety after the flood

pages.text: They missed the wagon ride and could not get a room at the inn. The son thought their luck was getting worse.

options: Many things seemed to go wrong for them

pages.text: They slept in a stable and continued their journey. The father stayed positive despite the difficulties.

question.text: What did the father do when problems happened?
options: He stayed hopeful and kept going

pages.text: Later, they learned the wagon had crashed and the inn had burned down. When they returned home, they found a treasure chest filled with jewels.

options: They found treasure and realized their luck was good

elements.correct: To find safety and rebuild their lives
Many things kept going wrong for them
They continued moving forward and stayed hopeful
They learned their bad luck led to good things
distractors: They stayed unlucky for the whole journey
They never learned why things went wrong
